'''2001 Rhode Island State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held at Holiday Inn, Boxborough, MA on 14 April 2001. [[Paul Maholick]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2075">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-mass-states-double-trd2075/ mass-states-double-tr], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-mass-states-double-trd2075/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn, Boxborough, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Maholick]]
